name: Qwen3-Next 80B-A3B

release_date.note: Raschka gallery date and HF repo creation

params.note: derived from config, main stack only, embeddings counted as active; adding the MTP layer (1,650,471,424) gives exactly the HF safetensors count; README: 80B total, 3B active

tokenizer.note: tokenizer.json: ByteLevel, 151,643 base tokens plus 26 added

mixers.note: 16 QK heads, 32 V heads, head dim 128; depthwise conv kernel 4
gated attention: 16 Q / 2 KV heads of 256, sigmoid output gate, QK-norm, RoPE on 64 dims

position.nope_layers: the 36 Gated DeltaNet layers carry no position encoding

moe.router: softmax top-10, renormalised; shared expert scaled by a sigmoid gate

stack.note: README: 12 x (3 x (Gated DeltaNet -> MoE) -> 1 x (Gated Attention -> MoE)); config full_attention_interval 4

steps.label: conv kernel 4 on q, k, v; gated RMSNorm on output
16 Q / 2 KV heads of 256, QK-norm, partial RoPE
sigmoid gate from q_proj on the attention output
1 gated shared + top-10 of 512 experts of width 512

specials.name: gated_deltanet
specials.what: linear-recurrent mixer with gated delta rule; 3 of every 4 layers

specials.name: gated_attention
specials.what: output of full attention multiplied by a sigmoid gate computed from the input

specials.name: short_conv
specials.what: depthwise convolution of kernel 4 on q, k, v inside Gated DeltaNet

specials.name: zero_centered_rmsnorm
specials.what: norm weights stored as offsets from 1 and weight-decayed

readme.note: Model Overview: 80B / 3B, hybrid layout, head counts, 512 experts, 262,144 native, up to 1,010,000

code.note: Qwen3NextDecoderLayer; RMSNorm output * (1 + weight); attn_output * sigmoid(gate); shared_expert_gate

gal.note: entry 'Qwen3 Next 80B-A3B': date, 12 gated attention + 36 DeltaNet

count.note: DeltaNet: d(2*16*128+32*128) + d*32*128 + 2d*32 + conv 6144*4 + 2*32 + 128 + 32*128*d; gated attention q_proj doubled; MoE router + 512 experts + shared expert and its gate
